[P2] Provide evidence for the AgentCore state guarantees

CONTRIBUTING rule 6 requires evidence for external-service assumptions or an explicit `unverified` label in the PR description. The PR reports only a build and local worker tests, which cannot establish AgentCore's process affinity or state replacement after session expiry. These guarantees affect whether developers can safely depend on earlier jobs' files and memory. Return to the design phase under rule 9: cite relevant service documentation or live-run evidence, or mark the unsupported assumptions `unverified` in the description.
